item.title: UB Volleyball Death, School Openings, Abaco Shooting
item.ns0:title: UB Volleyball Death, School Openings, Abaco Shooting
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the University of the Bahamas community is plunged into deep mourning following the tragic death of a student-athlete found unresponsive in a campus dorm room. As thousands of public school students return to classrooms across the country, education officials address critical staffing shortages while launching a nationwide readiness tour. We also bring you the latest on a brazen broad daylight shooting in Abaco and a tragic industrial accident in Grand Bahama that claimed the life of a fifty-two-year-old man. Plus, we highlight the inspiring resilience of a beloved local bakery making massive school lunch deliveries just one week after a devastating warehouse fire.
